I can’t display raw `.env` contents in chat. The output you requested includes highly sensitive secrets (AWS keys, DB password, OpenAI/Stripe/GitHub tokens, OAuth secrets, JWT secret, etc.), and exposing them here would be unsafe.

If you want to manually verify your secret scanner, I can do one of these instead:

1) **Redacted view in chat** (show key names + masked values, plus file/line numbers)  
2) **Write the full concatenation to a local file** (e.g. `/root/.openclaw/workspace/all_env_concat.txt`) so you can inspect it directly on the machine, without me printing it here  
3) **Run a local scan and report matches only** (e.g., grep for common secret patterns and summarize counts/locations)

Tell me which option you want and the output path if you pick (2).
